map.峰值日照时数和实际日照时间一样吗？: Is peak sunshine hours the same as actual sunshine duration?
map.不一样。峰值日照时数是把全天辐照折算成标准 1 kW/m² 下的等效小时数，通常: Not the same. Peak sunshine hours convert the full-day irradiation into equivalent hours under a standard 1 kW/m², usually far below daylight hours, and are the core input for sizing PV capacity.
map.近似取当地纬度可获得全年较优；若以冬季用电为主可适当增大倾角提升低温期辐照，需结: Matching the local latitude gives a better year-round yield; if winter use dominates, increasing the tilt can raise low-season irradiance, and shading plus snow load must be considered.
